Hero_Desc_ShadyTwisted:
Shady finally acknowledged her own weakness and the truth that she admired the Master.
To preserve order in the Ghost Swamp, thrown into confusion by chaos, she reversed her fear into courage.
With responsibility and patience, she restrains her true nature and works tirelessly as the Ghost Swamp's guardian.
Album_Like_ShadyTwisted: Time alone to vent her anger
Album_Hate_ShadyTwisted: Tasks that just keep piling up...
Album_Hobby_ShadyTwisted: Beating dolls that resemble troublesome ghosts
Album_Wish_ShadyTwisted: A peaceful Ghost Swamp where nothing goes wrong
Album_ShadyTwisted1: Shady's entire demeanor had changed when I met her again after a long absence. She says many things have happened in the meantime... What could she have experienced to assume such a new form?
Album_ShadyTwisted2: Shady calmly explained how her thinking had changed: she would no longer worry about the eyes of others, lie to her own heart, or refuse to admit what must be acknowledged. Her gaze as she spoke seemed profoundly different from before.
Album_ShadyTwisted3: Shady says that Rim's identity as an embodiment of chaos was one reason she changed her mind and decided to guard the Ghost Swamp. Shady, helping and protecting Rim... It is a somewhat unfamiliar sight. Of course, she still seems unable to endure the dreadful jokes Rim produces at every opportunity.
Album_ShadyTwisted4: Shady's appearance was not the only thing that changed. Her speech once overflowed with laughter and playful mischief, but now her tone is far calmer. When I mentioned this to her, however, she seemed slightly embarrassed.
Album_ShadyTwisted5: Shady has begun seeking me out at the Order more often. She visits whenever something troubles her because she wants my advice... I was surprised by how serious and profound those concerns were. They revealed how sincerely Shady regards her present role.
Album_ShadyTwisted6: The ghosts of the Ghost Swamp each seem confused by Shady's transformation. Shady, meanwhile, appears plagued by ghosts disturbing the swamp's peace... True peace still seems a long way off.
Album_ShadyTwisted7: I always wondered why Shady watched my reaction whenever she did anything. Then I heard the astonishing story that when she changed her ways, she chose me as her role model. But if I brought this up, Shady would furiously deny it, so I decided to remain silent.
LoveHero_ShadyTwisted: This feeling of being acknowledged by the Master... It is not bad.
LoveHeroCancel_ShadyTwisted: What... Was I not good enough? I worked hard!
Food_ChefNote_ShadyTwisted_Hate1: Shady's brow furrowed slightly at the sight of canned feed. Its appearance, flavor, and ingredients all seem unsuited to her tastes.
Food_ChefNote_ShadyTwisted_Hate2: When she received the pumpkin soup, she warned me to be careful, saying her former self would have overturned it. It seems even the present Shady remains sensitive about anything related to age.
Food_ChefNote_ShadyTwisted_Like1: She says seeing Garnet Fruit reminds her of the pranks she once played by taking it from place to place. She claims she no longer plays such tricks... Then why is she secretly slipping some into her pocket?
Food_ChefNote_ShadyTwisted_Like2: She seemed to like its distinctive appearance and merely stared for a long time without eating. When I pretended not to notice and tried to collect the plate, she startled and snatched it back.
Food_ChefNote_ShadyTwisted_Like3: She seems amused by the rice cake's chewy texture. She repeatedly rolled one around inside her mouth in play, then swallowed it whole.
Food_ChefNote_ShadyTwisted_Like4: She ate while grumbling about a ghost who once brought a buche de Noel to the Ghost Swamp and tried to plant it. Judging by how quickly she finished, it must have tasted good.
Food_ChefNote_ShadyTwisted_Like5: The refreshing flavor seems quite novel to her. Perhaps finding it addictive, she finished it in the blink of an eye, then tilted her head curiously.
Food_ChefNote_ShadyTwisted_Like6: Its smooth appearance and size, small enough to fit in one hand, seemed to suit her tastes. I worried that she might throw it somewhere, but fortunately nothing of the sort happened.
Food_ChefNote_ShadyTwisted_Like7: Seemingly intrigued by the small, adorable shape, she tossed them one after another into her mouth. When she dropped one, she glanced at me cautiously. I had no choice but to give her a refill.
Food_ChefNote_ShadyTwisted_Like8: She liked it, saying it might restore her energy whenever work as guardian of the Ghost Swamp left her exhausted. I made extra and wrapped it specially for her.
Food_ChefNote_ShadyTwisted_Like9: At first, she complained that candies blending so many flavors were confusing. Yet once she tasted them, she cleaned the plate without another objection.

LoveLetter_ShadyTwisted:
Master, I am firmly maintaining order in the Ghost Swamp. I no longer run away as I once did, and I am working to act responsibly, just as you showed me.
Enduring Rim's dreadful jokes is still an ordeal... but if it becomes unbearable, I can settle matters with a knock on the head, so do not worry.
Sometimes I wonder what I would be like now if I had never met you. But the present is what matters, is it not? Keep watching me from now on. I will protect this swamp perfectly, in my own way.
LoveCall_ShadyTwisted:
Master? Yes. It is Shady. I called... because you suddenly came to mind.
What? Why is it not a prank call for once? Hmph. It is not as though I do nothing but play tricks every day.
I am already busy enough cleaning up after all the trouble those ghosts cause.
How do you keep working without rest while looking after so many Apostles?
Honestly, you truly are impressive.
When I tried to follow your example, I began to understand.
Maintaining order with a sense of responsibility is incredibly busy and difficult work.

...Argh. Saying things like this still feels rather awkward.
Anyway! You understand the general idea, right, Master?
If you ever need my help, I will come and assist you.
I can open a dimensional portal and find you, so contact me without feeling burdened, understood?
Hehe. Until next time, Master!

Affinity_ShadyTwisted_EP01_002: Still, thanks to you, one burden has been lifted from my mind.
